reviews.text: Thank you, Valeria Ximena Sanchez Ucanan. We're delighted to hear your positive feedback on Arcaplanet! Thank you so much for your trust.
Thank you, Enrico Romita. We're delighted to hear your positive feedback about Arcaplanet! Thank you so much for your trust.
Highly trained staff and affordable costs
The staff are very kind and ready to help you.
Thank you, Ada Malusardi, for taking the time to share your review with us! Come visit us again soon at Arcaplanet stores!
Well-stocked store, always offering discounts and offers, and friendly staff.
Thank you, Sonia Gringa, we're delighted to hear your positive feedback on Arcaplanet! Thank you so much for your trust.
Extremely kind to customers and available to provide all the necessary explanations to allow us to best care for our beloved "friends"....

I thank the staff at the "Arcaplanet" store in Conca d'Oro for their helpfulness to customers, but above all for their sensitivity towards animal rights volunteers, who are always active and present in managing stray animals in our area.

Silvia

I've been a customer for many years and I must say that they always amaze me more and more, starting with the director Alessio, a very knowledgeable person on everything and surrounded by very high-level employees. Lately there has been a new hire, I think it's an intern named Alexis, who managed to surprise me by recommending products for my cat which he immediately liked. This means that "good blood does not lie" keep it up!!! Number 1!
Guys always available polite professional Manager exceptional person always available best shop of those visited without any doubt
Matteo, the shop assistant, is very experienced, kind and professional. It's difficult to find such kind people.
A pet store where you can find many savings. Friendly and knowledgeable staff.
A very well-stocked pet shop, from food to toys, to probiotics and anti-parasitics, with knowledgeable and friendly staff. One of my go-to places for my four-legged friends.
Great selection and kindness!

Good evening, I wanted to compliment Arcaplanet for the knowledge and helpfulness found in the Conca d'Oro store. Furthermore, being a volunteer for the "RESPECT FOR ALL ANIMALS" association, I have found that the customers in this neighborhood are very sensitive and generous towards our four-legged friends! CONGRATULATIONS! I would also like to thank Arcaplanet for the opportunity they give the association to be present in their stores, to have support in our "MISSION"! THANK YOU!

A truly wonderful experience at Arcaplanet – Via della Conca d’Oro (Rome), where I had the pleasure of participating in a food drive for needy animals, organized by the Balzoo association.
I would like to sincerely thank Alessio and his entire staff for their helpfulness, professionalism, and great sensitivity: they welcomed us with enthusiasm and supported us at every step.
A special thank you also goes to the wonderful customers, who participated with great generosity, making numerous donations and demonstrating the love and care they have for less fortunate animals.
Initiatives like these truly make a difference. Congratulations to Arcaplanet for the solidarity and human spirit that permeates this store! 🐾❤️

A well-stocked shop, with attentive and professional staff, ready to offer advice for every need.
Thanks to Alessio and all his staff!

Hello everyone, of all the Arcaplanet locations in Rome, the one in Conca d'Oro is definitely one of the best.
It has a warm, welcoming family atmosphere. During the food drives, you meet sensitive, kind, and generous people. The day spent at Conca d'Oro flies by, with smiles and kind words from the team... they collaborate with the volunteer associations and are at the same time professional, helpful, and positively responsive to customers... I thank everyone from the bottom of my heart, especially the Big Boss Alessio. ❤️ Anna, volunteer, Tana Libero Tutti Association

I spent the afternoon at this shop; we were collecting food for the furry friends of the IL RIFUGIO DELLE CODE FELICI ONLUS ASSOCIATION.
I wasn't familiar with this store because it's outside my area, but I can't help but appreciate the kindness, politeness, love, and professionalism of the staff here.
Starting with Alessio, the manager, Giada, and Paoletto.
They are very attentive to everything and everyone, and always smiling. I sincerely thank them for the wonderful afternoon they gave us and the opportunity they gave us, helping the furry friends of our association.
I highly recommend it to everyone.
Conca d'oro, very kind, friendly and knowledgeable... A small flaw in the dog harnesses, little choice

Good morning, I am a long-time customer of this STORE, but I must say that I have always been extremely satisfied with all the staff, starting with the director Alessio, but recently there has been a new resource named Matteo who I must truly congratulate MY MOST SINCERE VALUES for his preparation! CONGRATULATIONS, KEEP UP THE LIKE THIS!
Great prices for our pets

Very good shop, so many product. We had an airbnb nearby and we came to this shop to buy some stuff for our dog. She looooved the treat we bought for her. Unfortunately it is not available in Hungary :(
Well-stocked, friendly and qualified staff
Top shop! TOP staff, kindness is their forte, not to mention their knowledge of the products! EXCEPTIONAL! CONGRATULATIONS!
The staff is extremely courteous and kind! I highly recommend them.
Always kind and helpful

Knowledgeable, friendly, and always helpful staff.
Excellent products and always well-stocked.
Inexplicably rude clerk
Dishonest and truly incompetent people. A truly unpleasant experience where the customer is not taken into consideration at all.

I arrived at 8:31 PM on Friday after calling them five minutes earlier to let them know I'd be there right at closing time for my dog's urgent intestinal issues. They slammed the doors in my face for being just one minute late! It was my only option, and I had called them on purpose. Truly unacceptable and disrespectful behavior regarding my dog's urgent issue. I'm truly deeply disappointed with Arcaplanet—I will never return to this store or any other Arcaplanet store. What a horrible experience!

Everyone is always kind.
Thank you
High prices
Wide selection of products. Knowledgeable and courteous staff.

Perfect, very kind, and professional, not to mention the fact that they have everything for pampered dogs and cats.
I've been going to both the shop on Via di Priscilla and in Conca d'Oro for years, and they've never disappointed me.
I highly recommend Arcaplanet as a chain, one of the best in Rome.
Optimal
Very well stocked
Always kind

Extremely courteous and professional young staff
Unfortunately, there's no parking, and the police often catch you double-parked...
Part of a large pet supply chain. Average prices.
Kindness and professionalism
Very kind and knowledgeable staff, I always find what I'm looking for
Very friendly sales person
The shop is full of goods and always offers discounts. I have two cats and I practically always get my supplies from them. The staff is friendly.
Excellent quality/price ratio
